rules.statement: The applicant must operate an agricultural holding in its own name and for its own account, control the requested land, and meet active-farmer and agricultural-activity requirements.

result.description: Holding can satisfy the general applicant condition.

rules.statement: In the first ÖPUL participation year, the holding must have either at least 0.50 ha protected cultivation (A or GA) or at least 1.50 ha of the specified aggregate eligible area; the general size condition does not apply from year two.

result.description: General minimum holding size is met.

rules.statement: The measure's commitment and contract period is one calendar year, 1 January through 31 December.

result.description: Fulfil the conditions for the calendar-year commitment.

rules.statement: An annual contract automatically extends by one funding year unless it is deregistered; continuation is applied for by submitting the annual application with funding-relevant units.

result.description: Measure continues for the next funding year.

rules.statement: If no beneficial-organism use and therefore no NUE code occurs in a funding year, the measure contract expires; a renewed timely measure application is needed to participate again in the following year.

conditions.description: No NUE-coded use in the funding year.

result.description: No continuing eligibility without a new timely application.

rules.statement: The measure must be requested in the multiple-application measure application by 31 December before the contract starts in order to establish a valid contract for the next year.

result.description: Contract starts in the following funding year.

rules.statement: The last entry is funding year 2027, requiring application by 31 December 2026.

result.description: New entry is possible only through 2027.

rules.statement: Participation is excluded where the holding participates in an operational programme in which organism use is compensated, irrespective of whether the holding itself receives that compensation.

result.description: No prohibited double funding via operational programme.

rules.statement: At least one greenhouse or film tunnel must be managed in accordance with the measure in every participation year.

result.description: Minimum measure participation is met.

rules.statement: Eligible protected-cultivation areas are in fixed greenhouses with film, glass or plastic covering, or in unfixed film tunnels; soil, containers, pots and substrate culture are all eligible growing systems.

conditions.expression: protected_structure is an allowed greenhouse or tunnel
conditions.description: Structure must be within listed protected-cultivation types.

result.description: Protected-cultivation area can be included.

rules.statement: Sales, display and storage areas, and unused areas between tunnels or greenhouses, are not eligible; management aisles are eligible only to the necessary extent.

result.description: Only usable production area and necessary aisles are paid.

rules.statement: Each parcel requested for this measure must be identified in the multiple-application parcel list with code NUE.

result.description: Parcel is formally requested for the measure.

rules.statement: Eligible parcels with a greenhouse or film tunnel must use land-use type A (arable land) or GA (protected cultivation); soil-grown parcels use A, while pot or substrate culture uses GA.

conditions.expression: soil => A; pots or substrate => GA

result.description: Correct field-use type is submitted.

rules.statement: For a parcel alternately grown in soil and pots or substrate, cultivation on 1 April determines whether A or GA must be applied for, even if cultivation differs before or after that date.

result.description: Use type follows 1 April situation.

rules.statement: Organisms must be applied in at least one greenhouse or film tunnel according to dose rates in the AGES plant-protection product register; only applications replacing a plant-protection product use count.

result.description: Organism use fulfils the core obligation.

rules.statement: Use of only bumblebee colonies for pollination is not funded because they are not organisms listed in the plant-protection register and do not replace plant-protection-product use.

result.description: No measure payment for that use.

rules.statement: Parcel-specific records must state type and quantity of organisms, purchase evidence, reason and purpose, and date of use; another record format is accepted if it contains all required information.

conditions.description: All specified record fields and purchase evidence exist.

result.description: Recordkeeping obligation is fulfilled.

rules.statement: Protected-cultivation and arable parcels require proper establishment, annual proper care, and harvest plus removal of crop from at least 85% of the parcel.

conditions.description: General minimum management for protected cultivation.

result.description: General management criterion is met.

rules.statement: In 2026, the 85% harvest/removal condition is automatically recognised as force majeure without individual notice for specified drought districts, where no harvestable stand exists; payment remains granted. The 12 August notice extends this to named Styrian districts.

conditions.expression: year == 2026 and drought_no_harvestable_stand and district in listed_drought_districts

result.description: No 85% harvest/removal required and payment remains possible.

rules.statement: Exit is possible after fulfilling the one-year contract and must be reported online to AMA in the current multiple application. Deregistration between 1 January and 31 December makes the measure invalid for that funding year; after fulfilment through 31 December, deregistration may occur only from 1 January of the next year.

result.description: Measure ends without applying to a fulfilled current year.

rules.statement: The premium is EUR 2,000/ha in 2023 and EUR 2,160/ha from 2024 for protected-cultivation A and GA parcels.

result.description: EUR 2,000/ha in 2023; EUR 2,160/ha from 2024.

rules.statement: The premium may not be combined with any other premium on the individual parcel.

conditions.description: No other individual-area premium on NUE parcel.

result.description: Only standalone payment is possible.

rules.statement: According to Annex L, protected-cultivation areas in pot or substrate culture cannot be combined with any other measure.

result.description: No other measure may be combined on this area.

rules.statement: No ÖPUL premium is paid for, among other things, land not actively used for agricultural production, incorrectly identified or unrequested measure areas, and generally National Park areas (subject to listed exceptions that do not include this measure).

conditions.expression: active_agricultural_production and correctly_identified and not excluded_national_park

result.description: Area is not generally excluded from payment.

rules.statement: Administrative, on-site and subsequent controls check access conditions and commitments. Breaches can lead to warning or 2%, 5%, 10%, 25%, 50% or 100% reduction; two 100% reductions during the contract period cause exclusion and recovery, with warnings becoming 1% withholding from 2027.

conditions.description: Access, commitment, area, conditionality or contract breach.

result.description: Measure-related reduction, exclusion and/or recovery may apply.

rules.statement: All measure premiums are modulated by total holding area: 100% up to 200 ha, 90% for the portion over 200 to 300 ha, 85% over 300 to 1,000 ha, and 75% over 1,000 ha.

result.description: Apply weighted area-based payment factor.
